summary: Preserve Paprika import, snapshot export, and current recipe/item command surfaces in the generated MCP and tool registries.
reason: The generated CLI now includes an offline-first Paprika importer, a read-only AnyList snapshot export, field-preserving recipe updates, and verified item rename/barcode/package-size updates. Keep those commands discoverable through the MCP code registry and tools manifest, while documenting that unsupported item metadata writes remain unsupported and Paprika preview does not mutate AnyList.
validated_outcome: The MCP code registry exposes export, recipes.import-paprika, and recipes.update, with the expanded items.update caveat; the context registry reports the matching 46 endpoint surface; tools-manifest contains the recipe-update stdin and flag schema and metadata reports 47 manifest tools. JSON validation, focused Go tests, gofmt, and diff hygiene pass. No live AnyList writes were performed.
